title: JurisdictionRuleSet
description: Compliance/regulatory rules for ONE profession in ONE jurisdiction. One file per (profession, jurisdiction).

jurisdiction.description: ISO-style key: CA-ON, US-NY, GB, AU-NSW, DE

regulator.description: Legal body that grants the licence

gateway.description: Intake/verification body feeding the regulator, e.g. NNAS, CGFNS, physiciansapply.ca

regulated.description: false => title/practice not restricted in this jurisdiction

source.description: Regulator page the rules were read from

validity_months.description: how long this artifact stays valid once obtained

valid_at.description: the moment it must still be valid — the crux of expiry-collision reasoning

prerequisite_of.description: name of the requirement this must precede

depends_on.description: names of requirements that must complete first
